verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs publishes a machine-readable per-hour API price for Scribe v2 ($0.22/hour), so an agent can estimate a base transcription cost from audio duration before submitting. The pack shows no itemized pricing for add-ons such as keyterm prompting, entity detection/redaction, multichannel or realtime, so the full job cost is not computable from the evidence. Missing for 10: itemized add-on prices, distinct realtime vs batch rates, billing granularity/minimums, independent corroboration.
